services.name: Whale Report
services.desc: On this trip, we were fortunate enough to encounter a massive feeding event shortly after leaving the harbor. Good visibility allowed us to spot thousands of birds circling and diving a few miles ahead of us with no other vessels in sight. This indicates that there is a school of bait fish just below the surface, which is also a good sign that there is other marine life in the area as well. As we motored towards the commotion, we noticed thousands of common dolphins charging in the same direction.
